lines.description: London Euston to Manchester Piccadilly, return
lines.source: Itemised e-ticket, Avanti West Coast, Euston to Piccadilly return, 14 Oct, Standard Class
lines.policy: Rail travel is permitted in standard or economy class only. Higher classes require written VP pre-approval.
lines.evidence: Rail ticket E-01 was booked in Standard Class.
lines.claim: Rail ticket E-01 conformed to the travel policy.

lines.policy: The nightly hotel cap outside London is GBP 130. Rates above the cap are not reimbursable unless the manager approved the exception in writing before the stay.
lines.evidence: Hotel invoice E-02 shows a Manchester rate of GBP 195 per night. No manager approval was recorded.

fix.label: Attach manager's written pre-approval
fix.evidence: Hotel invoice E-02 shows a Manchester rate of GBP 195 per night. The manager approved this exception in writing before the stay.

lines.note: £195 a night, cap is £130, no approval

lines.source: Itemised receipt: salmon, salad, sparkling water, dessert
lines.policy: A dinner on business travel is permitted up to GBP 60 per person. Alcohol is prohibited.
lines.evidence: Dinner E-03 cost GBP 48.20, which is under GBP 60. One person dined. The bill has no alcohol.

lines.source: Itemised receipt: ribeye, two glasses of Malbec, side
lines.policy: A dinner on business travel is permitted up to GBP 60 per person. Alcohol is prohibited.
lines.evidence: Dinner receipt E-04 is for one person and totals GBP 71.40. The bill includes two glasses of wine.
lines.note: Includes wine, alcohol is not reimbursable

lines.source: Card statement line only: MANCHESTER CABS 34.00
lines.policy: Any expense over GBP 25 requires an itemised receipt.
lines.evidence: Taxi expense E-05 is GBP 34. No receipt has been provided.

fix.label: Upload the itemised receipt
fix.evidence: Taxi expense E-05 is GBP 34. An itemised receipt has been provided.

lines.description: Mileage, London to Manchester by personal car, 120 miles
lines.source: Mileage log says 120 miles by personal car, same day as the rail ticket E-01
lines.policy: Mileage is reimbursable only for a journey made by personal car.
lines.evidence: Rail ticket E-01 shows the traveller took the train from London to Manchester on 14 Oct. The mileage log E-06 shows the traveller drove the same journey on the same day.

fix.label: Withdraw the duplicate mileage claim
fix.evidence: Rail ticket E-01 shows the traveller took the train from London to Manchester on 14 Oct. The mileage log E-06 was withdrawn and the mileage claim was removed.

lines.note: Drove, but also claimed the train for the same trip

lines.source: App receipt, Piccadilly station to hotel, 23:10
lines.policy: Taxis are reimbursable when public transport is unavailable, which includes any journey starting after 22:00.
lines.evidence: Taxi receipt E-07 shows a journey starting at 23:10.

lines.source: Itemised receipt, 2 covers, GBP 118.00; attendees: Priya Nair, Tom Eccles (Halden Logistics); purpose: renewal pricing
lines.policy: Client entertainment is permitted up to GBP 80 per head when attendee names and business purpose are recorded.
lines.evidence: Lunch E-08 cost GBP 59 per head for 2 attendees. Both attendee names and the business purpose are recorded.
lines.claim: Client lunch E-08 conformed to the entertainment policy.
lines.note: £59 a head, names and purpose recorded

lines.source: Invoice dated 27 Aug 2026, report submitted 20 Oct 2026
lines.policy: Expenses must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date. Later claims are not reimbursable.
lines.evidence: Expense E-09 is dated 27 Aug 2026 and was submitted on 20 Oct 2026.

lines.policy: Reimbursable expense types are rail, hotels, meals, taxis, client entertainment and mileage.
lines.evidence: Expense E-10 is a car park charge of GBP 18. The policy does not mention parking.
lines.note: Parking is not a covered expense

lines.source: Cropped invoice scan, rate not visible
lines.policy: The nightly hotel cap outside London is GBP 130. Rates above the cap are not reimbursable.
lines.evidence: Hotel invoice E-11 is for one night in Leeds. The copy supplied is cropped and does not show the room rate.
lines.note: Invoice copy is cropped, rate not visible
